flake_identity.root_cause: LoginAttemptBudget.recordFailure aligns fixed windows to the REAL epoch (windowStart = floor(now/60_000)*60_000 via systemClock). The budget's injectable Clock seam (BudgetClock, T-MIG-010) existed but buildIdentityServices never exposed it, so route tests ran the budget on wall-clock time. The test's 9 sequential wrong-password logins each pay a bcrypt cost-12 compare (~2.5-3.5s total); when they straddle a real 60s window boundary, insideWindow(existing) goes false and recordFailure starts a FRESH window with count=1 — the counter silently resets and toBe(9) fails. Expected flake rate ~= loop-duration/60s (load-dependent), consistent with 2 occurrences across the fleet's full-suite runs.
